integrity: The covariance is reconstructed from exact three- and four-position rank probabilities. The inverse follows algebraically from the complete-graph incidence identity and is independently replayed with exact rational arithmetic. The originality claim excludes the elementary local covariance calculation and focuses on the full covariance/precision self-sparsity, spectrum, determinant, and partial-correlation classification.
scientific_limitations: Only covariance, precision, and least-squares partial correlations are classified; nonlinear conditional dependence is not.
The distribution-free extension requires iid continuous observations so that ranks are almost surely distinct and uniformly distributed.
Older ranking, social-choice, Hodge-decomposition, or linear-ordering literature may contain an equivalent incidence formulation.
title: Incidence precision law for all inversion indicators of a random permutation
